dog.description_text:
Hi, I’m Yoda! 💛 I’m a cute, friendly, and playful little pup who loves being around people. I’m gentle and affectionate, and I like to follow my humans around to see what they’re up to. But don’t worry, if you’re busy working, I’m happy to entertain myself with my favorite toys!

I love all my toys, especially chew toys that help soothe my teething. When it’s time to rest, I love having a cozy blanket in my crate to make my sleeping space extra comfortable. 💤

I enjoy meeting both kids and adults, and I’m generally friendly with other dogs, too! I can be a little shy around dogs that bark loudly, though, so a calm introduction helps me feel safe and comfortable.

Overall, I’m a sweet, easygoing, people-loving pup who enjoys playtime, cuddles, and cozy naps.

﻿Yoda is approximately 0y 3m 5d old and may be 45 to 55 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
